Dialogs.dc.html.title: Send print, Melody creator, command palette

sticky-titlebar.text:
Title bar shared by every screen: menus, search (opens the command palette), project tabs, and the printer chip.
Try: accent and motion tweaks on the screens that import it.
Not built natively yet: menus drawn as text buttons.

sticky-navrail.text:
Navigation rail shared by every screen.
Try: Tweaks > active destination.
Not built natively yet: the extra rail destinations.

sticky-tokens.text:
Graphite colour roles (dark and light), type, shape, elevation, motion.
Try: the accent tweak.
Built natively: colour roles; section labels are now sentence case at 13 px.

sticky-home.text:
Home: recent files, Online Models, Print History, LAN model drop, printers, Melody creator.
Try: accent and motion tweaks.
Not built natively yet: the Home navigation column.

sticky-main.text:
Prepare: floating 3D canvas, sidebar cards, gizmo rail, Slice and Print split buttons.
Try: Tweaks > Look.
Not built natively yet: rounded canvas corners, Ink list, Process tiles, Express print card.

sticky-preview.text:
Preview: view types, display options, legend, layer slider, move timeline.
Try: motion off for the static end state.
Not built natively yet: the Preview control layout.

sticky-device.text:
Device: camera, progress, speed, temperatures, AMS, control, fans, extras.
Native now: the cards use the 28 px corner from this board.
Open decision: rail label Device or Monitor.

sticky-deviceswitcher.text:
Quick printer switcher: a chip in the title bar on every page while a project is open; search by name, model or IP, with a regular expression toggle.
Try: click the chip, type in search, toggle .*, pick a printer.
Not built natively yet.

sticky-dialogs.text:
Send print job, Melody creator, command palette with regex search.
Try: accent swatches.
Not built natively yet: Send print and Melody creator layouts.

title-device.text: Graphite shell: Device and printer switching

sticky-toolsmenu.text:
Local tools menu in the title bar, between Objects and Calibration, holding the tools that used to sit at the bottom of File. Every feature opens the full feature list.
Try: accent and motion tweaks.
Built in the application (not yet driven): the menu, as one flat list. Group headings are a proposal. A loaded personal wording file can rename the menu.
